    AI Overview
    Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG) completed a 25-for-1 forward stock split on April 2, 2026, with trading on a split-adjusted basis starting April 6, 2026. Shareholders received 25 shares for every one held, reducing the stock price from over
    to around
    to increase liquidity and accessibility for retail investors. 
    Key Details of the BKNG Stock Split: 
    • Split Ratio: 25-for-1 forward stock split.
    • Effective Date: After hours on April 2, 2026.
    • Trading Date: Commenced trading on a split-adjusted basis on April 6, 2026.
    • Shareholder Record Date:
      March 6, 2026.
    • Purpose: To lower the high nominal share price ($\sim$
      ) and improve liquidity.
    • Authorization Increase: Authorized common shares increased from 1 billion to 25 billion. 
    Impact on Investors:
    The split does not change the underlying fundamentals, valuation, or company market cap; it simply breaks the shares into smaller, cheaper pieces. For every one share held before the split, an investor held 25 shares afterward, with each share valued at 1/25th of the pre-split price. 
    This information is based on reports from Yahoo Finance, Investing.com, and The Motley Fool.
